title: Large outbound transfer to external domain
rule_name: DLP-0117: Bulk data egress to non-corporate domain

context.user_baseline: Sends supplier packs to this domain 2-4 times per month

detail: 48 MB uploaded over HTTPS to mail.corp-partner-portal.com during working hours. The same host/domain pair has generated nine prior alerts, all closed as benign supplier correspondence. The user's role involves routine transfer of tender documents.
